title: Request latency above the warning threshold
symptoms: WARNING logs with 'Request latency exceeded warning threshold'

steps.title: Compare latency with the normal baseline
steps.description: Compare p50/p95 response times of the slow requests with normal requests for the same service and endpoint.

steps.title: Check for correlated errors in the same window
steps.description: Slow requests during error spikes often share a cause with timeouts or resource pressure.

steps.title: Check host and dependency saturation
steps.description: Review CPU, memory and downstream latency for the hosts serving the slow requests.

steps.title: Scale out the service
steps.description: Add capacity if slowness tracks load.

escalation: Owning team if p95 latency stays above threshold for 30 minutes.
